missing-purpose: Describe the method's independent purpose and result.
missing-contract: Describe significant inputs and result; tags are optional when concise prose covers the contract.
missing-explanations: Explain the reason for complex decisions near their control-flow region.
placeholder-documentation: Review placeholder or syntax-only documentation; this is a heuristic finding.
unresolved-inheritdoc: Resolve the explicit inherited contract before judging documentation coverage.
deep-nesting: Consider guard clauses or named stages while preserving evaluation order and behaviour.
large-method: Review responsibilities and name independent stages; do not split solely to improve a score.
many-dependencies: Review the method's dependency profile and role; orchestration may justify fan-out.
recursive-calls: A recursive call component needs an explicit termination explanation.
unknown-analysis: Some facts are unavailable; do not treat unknown values as healthy or missing documentation.
fragmentation: The change adds many helpers without reducing the logic inventory; review the complete path.
removed-method: A method was removed or renamed; review the mapping and retained behaviour.
regression: Health decreased under the same policy; explain or fix the specific reasons.
forecast-only: Planning is an estimate, not measured code or proof of preserved behaviour.
dense-boolean-expression: Review the connected boolean expression; name domain predicates or separate decisions while preserving short-circuit order and side effects.
deferred-logic-inventory: Local complexity excludes nested functions and closures. Review their separate declarations before judging this method or the complete path.
large-file: Much logic is concentrated in this file. Review responsibility cohesion; do not move lines solely to improve the score.
many-file-declarations: Many declarations share a file. Review independent responsibilities before splitting.
cross-file-coupling: The file calls many other files. Review boundaries and its orchestration role.
crowded-folder: Many selected files share one folder. Review domain grouping, not folder count alone.
cross-folder-coupling: Calls cross many folder boundaries. Review dependency direction and module contracts.
organization-cycle: An observed dependency cycle crosses files or folders. Review shared contracts and dependency direction.
file-fragmentation: Many connected tiny files may scatter one process. Review the path; independent DTOs are not penalized.
missing-parameter-description: Describe each named parameter; empty, placeholder and name-only descriptions do not count. Parameter coverage has a small fixed weight.
